findings.title: Cancelling a map dump dereferences a NULL file

impact.description: Escape at the map filename prompt crashes the C game (SIGSEGV); the guard returns safely. No lost-progress claim.

findings.notes: 59 C Borg units, no Rust Borg linked; direct function diagnostic in a normally born C game. Top-level Ctrl-Z dispatch and failed-open branch were not separately runtime-tested.
findings.next: Retain a legal/reachable normal-rule scenario, initialization/pins, actual before/after commands/outcomes and negative controls before marking a fix validated.

findings.title: Paralysis/knockout message suppression resets a different variable

impact.description: C reactions can remain suppressed after recovery; no actual later death/decision change observed.

findings.notes: Older imported C resets the global correctly. This is a newer C regression, not a Neo omission.
findings.next: Retain a legal/reachable normal-rule scenario, initialization/pins, actual before/after commands/outcomes and negative controls before marking a fix validated.

findings.title: West radius-two shoulder grids are omitted

impact.description: Native C marks 19 distinct grids versus 21 after correction; no meaningful gameplay outcome established.

findings.notes: Duplicate light-list entries are a separate symptom; avoid claiming two missing flags saved a life.
findings.next: Retain a legal/reachable normal-rule scenario, initialization/pins, actual before/after commands/outcomes and negative controls before marking a fix validated.

findings.title: Cold melee uses temporary acid resistance

impact.description: Can misestimate a cold blow when only one temporary resistance is active; real changed combat choice pending.

findings.notes: Independent of the other danger slips in the same Rust group.
findings.next: Retain a legal/reachable normal-rule scenario, initialization/pins, actual before/after commands/outcomes and negative controls before marking a fix validated.

findings.title: Black Market Teleport Other rod class exception is reversed

impact.description: A useful escape device can be rejected for the wrong class; real purchase/survival effect pending.

findings.notes: Both current C and src/store/buy.ts use !=MAGE && ==ROGUE.
findings.next: Retain a legal/reachable normal-rule scenario, initialization/pins, actual before/after commands/outcomes and negative controls before marking a fix validated.

findings.title: Starvation shopping exception admits unrelated scrolls/subtypes

impact.description: A starving character can consider unrelated supplies; no observed starvation or loss of gold proved.

findings.notes: Both C and src/store/buy.ts use the conjunction that exempts every scroll and any matching numeric sval.
findings.next: Retain a legal/reachable normal-rule scenario, initialization/pins, actual before/after commands/outcomes and negative controls before marking a fix validated.

findings.title: Home trial early exits leave reduced quantities/charges

impact.description: Later C trials can see a modified home snapshot; real item loss is not claimed.

findings.notes: C decrements before the two-empty-slot continue. TS BuySim path does not mutate those wares.
findings.next: Retain a legal/reachable normal-rule scenario, initialization/pins, actual before/after commands/outcomes and negative controls before marking a fix validated.

findings.title: Ring-side scores persist across home wares

impact.description: C can compare a ring using an earlier ware's score when the other slot holds the One Ring.

findings.notes: p_left/p_right declared outside the loop; current TS helper has no corresponding accumulators. Broader ring parity is independent.
findings.next: Retain a legal/reachable normal-rule scenario, initialization/pins, actual before/after commands/outcomes and negative controls before marking a fix validated.

findings.title: Home ring trials use asymmetric quantities

impact.description: Potential unequal left/right power trial; legal qty>1 ring reachability remains unproven.

findings.notes: Do not fabricate stacked-ring gameplay or call this a proven bad equip decision.
findings.next: Retain a legal/reachable normal-rule scenario, initialization/pins, actual before/after commands/outcomes and negative controls before marking a fix validated.

findings.title: Home grab skip flag leaks to later wares

impact.description: Once one recently sold ware is skipped, later C wares may be skipped too.

findings.notes: TS src/store/buy.ts declares let skip=false inside each ware loop.
findings.next: Retain a legal/reachable normal-rule scenario, initialization/pins, actual before/after commands/outcomes and negative controls before marking a fix validated.

findings.title: No-hole swap exit leaves valuation changed

impact.description: C returns with swap value -1 instead of restoring it; next real decision impact unproven.

findings.notes: TS returns through an optional evaluation seam and has no corresponding global mutation. #4 missing swap functionality is a separate port gap.
findings.next: Retain a legal/reachable normal-rule scenario, initialization/pins, actual before/after commands/outcomes and negative controls before marking a fix validated.

findings.title: Swap trials overwrite the tracked swap inventory slot

impact.description: C's model can lose its old swap item until inventory refresh; no actual game item destruction claimed.

findings.notes: The TS evaluator does not copy candidates over a mutable C inventory array.
findings.next: Retain a legal/reachable normal-rule scenario, initialization/pins, actual before/after commands/outcomes and negative controls before marking a fix validated.

findings.title: Latest purchase/sale is outside the history reader range

impact.description: Immediate buy-back/resale suppression can miss the newest record; full transaction scenario pending.

findings.notes: Writers store a last index, readers scan p<num. Group34's purchase half shares the cause already reported in33; one catalogue entry.
findings.next: Retain a legal/reachable normal-rule scenario, initialization/pins, actual before/after commands/outcomes and negative controls before marking a fix validated.

findings.title: Ten-entry transaction arrays never use the tenth slot

impact.description: History capacity is nine rather than ten; whether this is intentional or harmful remains unproven.

findings.notes: Keep this separate from the latest-entry omission; do not inflate it into a gameplay failure.
findings.next: Retain a legal/reachable normal-rule scenario, initialization/pins, actual before/after commands/outcomes and negative controls before marking a fix validated.

findings.title: Critical escape returns with pretend full mana

impact.description: C trait state retains MAXSP until notice refresh after a successful critical attempt; later bad choice unproven.

findings.notes: TS never assigns pretend full mana here. Its over-exertion parity is a separate question, not this leak.
findings.next: Retain a legal/reachable normal-rule scenario, initialization/pins, actual before/after commands/outcomes and negative controls before marking a fix validated.

findings.title: Stair predicate queues a climb before phase guards finish

impact.description: C may leave climb keys queued or queue both climb and phase while applying phase bookkeeping.

findings.notes: TS returns commands rather than queuing keys: a stair AgentCommand used as a boolean is discarded. See PORT-0001; this is not the same faithful C queue symptom.
findings.next: Retain a legal/reachable normal-rule scenario, initialization/pins, actual before/after commands/outcomes and negative controls before marking a fix validated.

findings.title: Guarded anti-summon timer reset is unreachable

impact.description: A >50 guarded branch cannot execute its nested <50 reset; practical need for that reset unproven.

findings.notes: TS resetAntisummon applies the same <50 test in those branches. Other call sites can still reset it.
findings.next: Retain a legal/reachable normal-rule scenario, initialization/pins, actual before/after commands/outcomes and negative controls before marking a fix validated.

findings.title: Dimension Door destination lacks legality/range filters

impact.description: An emergency target can be a rejected destination; actual engine outcome still needs a legal scenario.

findings.notes: C also ignores borg_spell's result; TS returns it. Missing floor/occupancy/range selection guards are shared.
findings.next: Retain a legal/reachable normal-rule scenario, initialization/pins, actual before/after commands/outcomes and negative controls before marking a fix validated.
